scraped.scraped_description: Names, parties and wards of all UK councillors, up-to-date, free to access. Stakeholder communication and campaign datasets with councillor emails and roles / portfolios. Details of by-elections and local elections. All English, Welsh, Scottish and Northern Irish councils, including the Corporation of the City of London and the Council of the Isles of Scilly.

policy_outcomes: Tracks GB councillor compositions across 18,645 councillors across 369 councils (as of 08-03-2026) and 462 Northern Ireland councillors. Provides historical composition data from 1973-2025 for GB and 2014-2025 for Northern Ireland. Maintains by-election archive (2021-25) and tracks party distribution across multiple governance models.
